exceptions.scope: Tailwind 3 build/watch glob parsing through micromatch and chokidar; braces 3.0.3 with locked pnpm patch
exceptions.reason: The registry has no patched release as of 2026-10-03. Version-only audit cannot recognize the locally patched parser and AST walkers.
exceptions.mitigation: patches/braces@3.0.3.patch enforces a nesting limit before parser descent and in compile/expand/stringify, including direct AST inputs. Frozen pnpm installs bind the patch hash; Docker copies the patch before installation. CI runs scripts/security/braces-depth.test.mjs against the actual Tailwind dependency paths before evaluating this entry.
exceptions.track: BRACES_NESTING_PATCH: replace the local patch with an upstream fixed release when available; remove this exact advisory entry at the same time
